8a362171-525f-4771-9be2-524b588c87c6.sectionTitle: Calm Is Part of the Buyout Section

_ww-text_text.en: Three days. A lifetime of memories.
Arrive at leisure. Setup begins with our team in full swing. The property is yours · explore every corner, let the dogs run free, breathe it in.
Quiet power for the weekend ahead.
When the last guest leaves, we do not go dormant. Off-season is paths, ponds, barn details, and on-site solar the next year's couples feel but never see. Stewardship is part of the luxury.
Handbuilt timber-peg barn & grounds for ceremony + reception
Cozy dual-fireplace lodge to steal a quiet moment together before the celebration begins. Wake up Sunday morning with coffee on the porch and the woods all around.
Every tour is private and unhurried. Bring your season or month, approximate guest count, and whether Thursday or Sunday works better.
